name: CT scan of the head (no contrast)
keywords: ct cat head brain scan concussion injury bleeding fall child

name: CT scan of the sinuses (no contrast)
keywords: ct sinus sinusitis face
about: A CT of the sinuses, usually for long-lasting sinus infections or before sinus surgery.

name: CT scan of the chest (no contrast)
keywords: ct chest lung nodule cough
about: A detailed scan of the lungs and chest, for example to follow a lung nodule.

name: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening
keywords: lung cancer screening low dose ct smoker
about: A yearly low-dose chest CT for people at high risk of lung cancer. Often covered at $0 as preventive care.

name: CT scan of the abdomen & pelvis (no contrast)
keywords: ct abdomen pelvis kidney stone flank pain no contrast
about: A CT of the belly and pelvis without dye, commonly used to look for kidney stones.

name: CT scan of the abdomen & pelvis (with contrast)
keywords: ct cat abdomen pelvis belly stomach appendicitis contrast
about: A CT of the belly and pelvis with IV dye, for abdominal pain, infections or cancer staging.

name: CT scan of the neck spine (no contrast)
keywords: ct cervical spine neck injury
about: A CT of the bones of the neck, often after an accident.

name: MRI of the brain (no contrast)
keywords: mri brain head neuro headache
about: A magnetic scan of the brain without dye.

name: MRI of the brain (without & with contrast)
keywords: mri brain head contrast neuro headache ms stroke seizure tumor

name: MRI of the neck spine (no contrast)
keywords: mri cervical spine neck pain arm numbness

name: MRI of the lower back (no contrast)
keywords: mri lumbar spine lower back sciatica disc herniation back pain

name: MRI of the knee, ankle or hip joint (no contrast)
keywords: mri knee ankle hip joint leg acl meniscus sports injury
about: A magnetic scan of one leg joint (most often the knee) for torn ligaments or cartilage.

name: MRI of the shoulder, elbow or wrist joint (no contrast)
keywords: mri shoulder rotator cuff elbow wrist joint arm
about: A magnetic scan of one arm joint, often the shoulder for rotator cuff injuries.

name: MRI of the abdomen (without & with contrast)
keywords: mri abdomen liver pancreas kidney
about: A magnetic scan of the liver, pancreas and kidneys with IV dye.

name: Ultrasound of the abdomen (complete)
keywords: ultrasound sonogram abdomen liver gallbladder gallstones kidney

name: Ultrasound of the abdomen (limited, e.g. gallbladder)
keywords: ultrasound gallbladder right upper quadrant limited
about: A focused ultrasound of one area, most often the gallbladder.

name: Pelvic ultrasound (through the belly, non-pregnancy)
keywords: ultrasound pelvis uterus ovaries bladder

name: Transvaginal ultrasound (non-pregnancy)
keywords: ultrasound transvaginal pelvic uterus ovaries gynecology

name: Pregnancy ultrasound (after 14 weeks, one baby)
keywords: ultrasound pregnancy ob obstetric anatomy scan baby prenatal sonogram
about: A standard ultrasound in the 2nd or 3rd trimester to check the baby's growth and anatomy.

name: Ultrasound of the thyroid / neck
keywords: ultrasound thyroid neck nodule
about: A sound-wave scan of the thyroid and neck.

name: Breast ultrasound (one breast, limited)
keywords: ultrasound breast lump
about: A focused ultrasound of a breast lump or a spot seen on a mammogram.

name: Ultrasound of the neck arteries (carotid)
keywords: carotid ultrasound duplex stroke neck arteries
about: Checks the neck arteries for narrowing.

name: Diagnostic mammogram (one breast)
keywords: mammogram mammography breast diagnostic lump
about: A detailed mammogram of one breast to follow up a lump, a symptom or an abnormal screening.

name: Diagnostic mammogram (both breasts)
keywords: mammogram mammography breast diagnostic both
about: A detailed mammogram of both breasts after a symptom or an abnormal screening.

name: Screening mammogram (both breasts)
keywords: mammogram screening yearly breast cancer
about: The routine yearly mammogram for people with no symptoms. Usually covered at $0 as preventive care.

name: Bone density scan (DEXA)
keywords: dexa bone density osteoporosis dxa
about: A low-dose X-ray that measures bone strength.

name: Chest X-ray (2 views)
keywords: xray x-ray chest pneumonia cough lungs

name: X-ray of the lower back (4+ views)
keywords: xray x-ray lumbar spine lower back radiograph
about: X-ray pictures of the lower spine from at least four angles.

name: X-ray of the knee (3 views)
keywords: xray x-ray knee injury arthritis
about: Three X-ray pictures of the knee.

name: X-ray of the shoulder (2+ views)
keywords: xray x-ray shoulder injury

name: X-ray of the ankle (3+ views)
keywords: xray x-ray ankle sprain fracture

name: X-ray of the hand (3+ views)
keywords: xray x-ray hand finger fracture

name: PET/CT scan (skull base to mid-thigh)
keywords: pet ct cancer staging scan

name: Office visit — new patient (moderate)

name: Office visit — returning patient (moderate)

name: Urgent care visit

name: Talk therapy session (38–52 minutes)

name: Therapy intake evaluation
keywords: therapy intake first session psychological evaluation counselor
about: The first session with a therapist, counselor or psychologist to understand what you need.

keywords: echo echocardiogram heart ultrasound murmur heart failure

keywords: stress test treadmill exercise heart chest pain
